items.headline: Nvidia to Report Q1 FY2027 Earnings on May 20 Amid China Clearance for H200 Chips
items.summary: US govt cleared ~10 Chinese firms to purchase Nvidia H200 chips; CEO Jensen Huang joining Trump delegation to Beijing signals potential reopening of commercial relations. Prediction markets show 90% implied probability of beat.

items.headline: Wall Street Raises NVDA Price Targets Ahead of May 20 Earnings
items.summary: BofA lifted target to $320, Wells Fargo to $315, UBS to $275 reflecting consensus that AI infrastructure spending cycle shows no signs of slowing. Goldman Sachs forecasting beat of ~$2B on consensus $78.8B revenue estimate.

items.headline: Broadcom: $100B+ AI Revenue Target for 2027 on Custom Chip Momentum
items.summary: CEO Hock Tan announced line of sight to $100B+ in AI chip revenue in 2027, with supply chain secured. Q1 AI semiconductor revenue surged 106% YoY to $8.4B; Q2 guidance calls for $10.7B.

items.headline: Cisco Soars 17% on Better-Than-Expected Guidance and AI Pivot
items.summary: Q4 guidance of $16.7-16.9B revenue beat consensus $15.8B; company cutting ~4,000 jobs (<5% workforce) to sharpen AI focus and boost margins. FY2026 guidance raised reflecting AI infrastructure tailwinds.

items.headline: Cerebras IPO Soars 99% to $350/Share; Largest Semiconductor IPO on Record
items.summary: AI chipmaker priced at $185/share, opened at $350; $5.55B fundraise largest semiconductor IPO ever. Cerebras focuses on inference speed; OpenAI and Amazon already customers.

items.headline: Meta Faces Regulatory Scrutiny & Internal Unrest Over $10B Louisiana Data Center
items.summary: Meta navigating aggressive AI initiatives including $10B Louisiana facility investment amid regulatory headwinds. Recent cash burn and legal pressures could impact growth despite strong capex commitments.

items.headline: Microsoft Cuts LinkedIn 5% Amid AI Capex & Valuation Pressure
items.summary: Microsoft restructuring LinkedIn operations with ~5% staff reductions while doubling down on AI investments. Shares down 28% from target valuations; strong earnings growth from AI adoption expected to continue.

items.headline: Tesla Navigating China Market Challenges; FSD Strategy Under Review
items.summary: Tesla facing challenging Chinese market environment while exploring new financing options. Recent discussions with Chinese leadership could impact FSD expansion strategy and future operations.

items.headline: AI Data Center Build-Out Driving 64% YTD Gain in Semiconductor Index
items.summary: PHLX Semiconductor Index (SOX) up 64% since end of March despite 10-year Treasury yield near 4.48% highs. AI infrastructure build-out momentum offsetting traditional yield headwinds on growth equities.
